title: Cross-Workspace Role Insights + Remediation Heatmap
creator: Asha Nair
description: Goal: Design a compact, actionable cross-workspace RBAC insights view that highlights risky role footprints, temporal access spikes, and single-click remediation suggestions. Scope: prototype a dashboard-level heatmap and an inline remediation flow for admins that works across multiple workspaces in a single org. Out of scope: backend implemention details for inference of risky roles; this ticket focuses on UX and prototype handoff. Rationale: Customers managing 5+ workspaces struggle to identify where broad roles or recently-modified permissions create exposure. The heatmap should let an admin spot high-risk clusters, drill into affected workspaces, and apply a least-privilege remediation (role tweak, time-bounded expiry, or access review) with clear audit trail links.
acceptance_criteria: Landing heatmap mock exists in Figma with at least 3 density encodings (role breadth, active sessions, recent grants)
Clicking a heatmap cell drills to a workspace panel listing users, roles, last grant date, and suggested remediation actions
Remediation action modal flow prototypes include confirmation text, impact estimation, and link to audit log entry
Design tokens and spacing follow Console design system; accessible color contrasts for heatmap provided
Handoff artifacts include component-level specs and interaction notes for ENG-7191 and ENG-7220
proposed_screens: Figma: Drilldown — Workspace Role List (frame: CW-Drilldown)
Figma: Remediation Modal — Suggest/Apply Change (frame: CW-Remediate)
Figma: Audit Link Flow — Timeline Context (frame: CW-Audit-Context)
design_notes: Heatmap axes: X = role families (custom, admin, billing, viewer, dedicated-runner), Y = workspace clusters (by activity or org tag)
Density encodings: color intensity for number of principals; accent overlay for active sessions; small sparkline for grant rate over 30 days
Interaction: hover shows summary tooltip; keyboard focus moves between cells; Enter opens drilldown panel; 'r' hotkey triggers quick remediation flow
Remediation suggestions are conservative by default (recommend read-only first) and show potential downstream impact (e.g., pipeline break) pulled from dependency metadata
Accessibility: ensure color is not sole channel (pattern overlays) and provide a table alternative export for screen readers and CSV
Trade-offs considered: compactness vs. discoverability — we prioritize ability to scan risk quickly for admins managing 20+ workspaces
Privacy: do not display PII in default hover; require expanded view for user email which is gated by viewer permissions
